groups.title: 1 · No survey: uncertainty waypoints + RPCBF
groups.description: Starts with no wind measurements. The robot selects uncertainty waypoints and receives actual local measurements. MBD requires whole-map RMSE ≤ 0.20 m/s. These are bounded tests of requested 300-second missions; the exact completed durations and stopping reasons are shown.
groups.result: Neither unrestricted GP accuracy nor low reported uncertainty certifies safe coverage. Check the recorded infeasible commands, coverage and error; a partial collision-free run is not a completed safe mission.

groups.title: 2 · Accurate learned map: MBD + RPCBF
groups.description: Starts from the GP fitted to 2,361 noisy full-coverage measurements in the unrestricted diagnostic. This is not a flown survey and is not known wind: MBD and RPCBF receive the learned posterior. Live measurements continue. The one-second warm planning limit remains enforced.
groups.result: These bounded MBD attempts stopped at the planning-time limit. Their timings overlapped other test processes; use the isolated benchmark below for the runtime conclusion. No successful 300-second learned-wind MBD mission is claimed.

overview:
The full system is not validated yet. The GP passes the unrestricted mean-accuracy test, but robot-path coverage, confidence calibration, filter feasibility and the one-second planning budget remain separate requirements.

Full suite: 441 passed, 5 failed, 2 timed out. New results are appended here; earlier recordings are preserved.
evidence:
Isolated 15-second trajectory benchmark: 1.16–2.03 seconds per call on CPU. Compilation is excluded. Kernel-training and observation-only calls are shown separately. No GPU runtime is claimed.

Startup filter check: 24/24 feasible first commands across all six declared initial conditions, both scenarios and both initial beliefs. Every command is finite and within actuator limits. This checks startup only; later infeasible commands in the recordings show why it cannot certify a mission. Every startup state and command.

The refined sampler uses the same POAM posterior and 32-node spectral quadrature, with 2,607 spatial support points. Measured covariance error falls from 49–52% to 1.3–1.4%. The cubic cache is refined from 0.2 to 0.1 m, reducing tested interpolation RMSE to 0.011 m/s. These are numerical refinements; the double-integrator state, quadratic aerodynamic force, fixed wind field, clarity equations, waypoint policy and MBD chains are unchanged.

RPCBF retains two coherent backup fields, a 1.2-second backup horizon, the full spline minimum, componentwise ±1.6 m/s² control limits, the existing pointwise 3√(σ²+0.1²) wind disk, and robust wall constraints. The bound is statistical and is not calibrated everywhere. An infeasible hard QP uses the existing logged minimum-slack fallback. These tests do not establish a global safety guarantee.

The five unit-test failures are four archived-demo assertions and a configuration test that tries to load environment YAML as planner configuration. The continuation cases using 0.1-second observations exceeded their individual 120-second limits. Failures are retained rather than weakening their assertions.
